title: Manage your calendar and tasks by text.
excerpt: Manage your calendar by text. Bee books events, invites people and attaches video links, from a plain message.
content_html:
Not another app to download! Just text me on:

Google Calendar

Lunch with Sara

Thursday · 1:00 – 1:30 PM

Bee

Lunch with Sara Thursday 1pm

Google Tasks

  • Renew my passport

    Due Friday

Seamless integration with:

No app. No forms. Just text.

Bee lives in the app you already text from, so scheduling costs you one sentence instead of six taps.

1

Text it like a person

“Dentist next Tuesday at 3” is a complete instruction. No fields, no date picker, no menus.

2

It lands on your calendar

Events sync straight to Google Calendar with guests invited and a Meet link attached when you ask for one. To-dos go to Google Tasks.

3

You get nudged in time

A reminder 15 minutes before anything starts, and a summary each morning of what the day holds.

Simple pricing

Try it free. Keep it for less than a coffee a month.

Pro

$9 / month

  • 100 messages a day — about 3,000 a month
  • Sync with Google Calendar and Google Tasks
  • Guest invites and Google Meet links
  • Event reminders and a morning summary
  • Cancel any time, from a text

Start free

10 messages a day, free forever. No card, no signup form — connecting your Google account takes one tap when you're ready.
